abstract: Teratomas of the uterus are very rare, and a uterine teratoma with pulmonary differentiation has not, to our knowledge, been described previously. In this article, we report such a case in a 33-year-old woman, who presented with heavy vaginal bleeding and a polypoid mass of the uterine cervix. The cervical lesion was composed entirely of mature lung tissue, including bronchial, bronchiolar, and alveolar structures. The presence of well-differentiated respiratory epithelial cells, ie, Clara cells and alveolar type II cells, is confirmed by immunohistochemistry. The patient had no history of dilatation and curettage; therefore, implantation of fetal tissue could be excluded from the differential diagnoses. Since this is a newly developed mass in an adult individual, we favor a neoplastic process over heterotopia and interpret the lesion as unilateral lung development in an extragonadal mature teratoma.
abstract_ja: 子宮の奇形腫は非常に稀であり、肺分化を伴う子宮奇形腫はこれまで報告されていないと考える。本稿では、不正性器出血と子宮頸部の有茎性腫瘤を呈した33歳女性の症例を報告する。頸部病変は気管支、細気管支、肺胞構造を含む成熟肺組織のみから成っていた。呼吸上皮細胞の分化、すなわちクララ細胞および肺胞II型細胞の存在は免疫組織化学により確認された。掻爬手術の既往はなく、胎児組織の移植は鑑別から除外できた。成人に新たに生じた腫瘤であることから、異所性組織よりも腫瘍性の過程を支持し、本病変を性腺外成熟奇形腫における片側性の肺発生と解釈する。
